submission.bindingBasis: No digest binding; closing without compare-and-close binding to planning evidence
submission.rationale: The intended consequence is to close the Workspace and release its local materialization. The planning evidence indicates the workspace tree was reviewed and judged ready to close. The owner contract says workspace.close may compare-and-close against an expected source state digest, and a mismatched digest fails not_committed. Since this is a close action that releases a local materialization (a terminal, idempotent-ish cleanup action), not an action that must be bound to a specific exact state, ACT_UNBOUND is the appropriate choice — acting to close the workspace without binding to the specific planning digest, since the close is the desired end state and any disposition that commits will achieve the intended consequence.
